entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need to return an item I bought a couple of weeks ago. It's a helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you please provide me with your order number?
Sure, it's VF886-01. It was a gift, and the box is still unopened. It just wasn't the right item.
Thank you. I see the order for the Pro-Ride Helmet here. Just to be clear, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the item or more of a preference?
Oh, it's just a preference. The color wasn't what my son wanted. He's very particular about his gear matching.

I understand completely. Let me just check the policy. Okay, I see your order was delivered 13 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window. I've just authorized the return for you.

That's great, thank you. I appreciate how easy that was. Now, since I'll be buying a replacement helmet from you, is there any chance you could provide a small discount code for the new purchase? It would help offset the hassle of the return.
I'm glad I could approve the return for you. However, our system doesn't allow for discount codes on return-related exchanges. The standard resolution is the full refund, which I've processed.
I see. Well, is the return shipping at least covered? Getting the right gear is important, especially when it comes to safety, and I'd like to get the new one ordered quickly.
Yes, absolutely. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. You can just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Okay, a prepaid label works for me. That's a fair solution. Thanks for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Have a good day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
